description: This file is a PHP script that retrieves a list of users with a specific project right in the TestLink application. It initializes the page, checks user rights, and outputs JSON data with user information.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the TestLink system, capable of retrieving user names for a specific project right.

methods.name: getNamesForProjectRight
methods.description: Retrieves the list of user names associated with a specific project right for this user object.
